blueprint.goal: Explain why the three angles of any triangle add up to 180 degrees
successCriteria: Learner explains that the three angles rearrange into a straight line
Learner finds a missing angle from the other two

anchor.instructionalQuestion: Why do the three corner angles always fill a straight line?

stages.objective: Meet the triangle and its three corner angles

checks.questionOrTask: Which corner of the triangle looks the widest to you?

stages.objective: See the three angles fill the straight line
stages.learnerOpportunity: Predict the total before the sum is revealed

checks.questionOrTask: If we slide all three angles onto the straight line, how much of it do you think they fill?

stages.objective: Use the sum to find a missing angle
stages.learnerOpportunity: Work out the third angle aloud from two given angles

checks.questionOrTask: A triangle has angles of 60 degrees and 80 degrees. What must the third angle be?

stages.objective: Say the rule in their own words
stages.learnerOpportunity: Explain the straight-line idea to a friend
